recipes.name: attn_missing_scale
recipes.detail: unscaled q@k under fp16 + large QKV → nonfinite at step 1; scaled control finite
recipes.fix: scale by 1/sqrt(d_h); prefer SDPA / flash-attn; keep LM init scales

recipes.name: fully_padded_softmax
recipes.detail: all-masked attention row → softmax(-inf,…)=NaN (batch has fully-padded row; logits finite=False)
recipes.fix: drop empty rows before forward; never fully-mask a query row

recipes.name: amp_no_scaler
recipes.detail: autocast fp16 without GradScaler → nonfinite at step 4
recipes.fix: use GradScaler (or BF16); unscale + inf check before step

recipes.name: handrolled_masked_nll
recipes.detail: mask*log_softmax on fully-padded row → nonfinite; 0*(-inf)=nan; fixed_ce finite=True
recipes.fix: use F.cross_entropy(..., ignore_index=-100); never mask*log_softmax

recipes.name: empty_valid_token_mean
recipes.detail: LM token-mean with 0 valid targets → nan
recipes.fix: skip empty microbatches OR clamp denom; never divide by valid_count==0

recipes.name: adam_moment_poison
recipes.detail: AMP overflow at step 4 stepped into Adam; moment_nan=True param_nan=True
recipes.fix: skip optimizer.step on nonfinite grads; reset Adam state after an incident

recipes.name: ddp_nan_contagion
recipes.detail: ranks reporting nonfinite=2/2 (seeded by fully-padded pack on rank 0)
recipes.fix: per-rank isfinite before step; quarantine offending batch/rank
